Class ConversionUtils

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.controller.utils.ConversionUtils
public class ConversionUtils extends Object
Utility class for converting ship board objects to player-related string identifiers. Provides methods to convert ShipBoard objects to player nicknames in various collection types.
